properties.name: A lesson is generalised before it is built — reflow2 is not tuned to the project that happened to reveal the problem
properties.statement:
When a defect is found in one design, ask what the GENERAL form is before building anything. A detector, threshold or guard fitted to the project that happened to expose the problem makes reflow2 better at that project and worse everywhere else.

ANTHONY'S WORDS, 2026-08-14: *"I don't want to be hyper focused on solving this by creating another requirement which then causes another issue later on. I don't want this to become like a decision tree where it is so specialized to some training data that it is no longer generalizable."*

⭐ THE PRINCIPLE ALREADY EXISTED IN THREE PLACES AND HAD NO HOME — which is why it kept being re-derived and re-failed:
  · `req:the-tool-finds-its-own-blind-spots` (accepted): *"a detector that reaches zero findings by only asking questions the graph can already answer HAS BEEN TUNED TO THE INSTRUMENT. Satisfying this requirement by adding checks that happen to pass is the failure mode, not the fix."*
  · BL-5's lesson, in a `detect.rs` comment: **a loud detector needs a different QUESTION, not a tuned number.**
  · `dec:idea-silence-is-reported-not-inferred`, where the concern was raised again.

THREE MEASURED INSTANCES OF THE FAILURE, each found by a person or agent working by hand rather than by any check:
  1. `chg:orphan-decision-degree-zero` (2026-08-01) — a clean bill from every detector; zero-degree nodes counted by hand. **One detector was added for that one case.**
  2. `req:the-tool-finds-its-own-blind-spots` (2026-08-07) — six blind spots, all found by hand.
  3. 2026-08-14 — 43 live planned capabilities invisible to every tool (`fact:the-build-list-is-suppressed-by-realized-via-component`); an agent had to leave the graph and grep the tree.

📌 THE POSITIVE FORM, because a rule stated only as a prohibition is hard to act on: `granularity_report` is the pattern to copy. It answers a judgement-shaped question — *is the build coarser than the design?* — with **no threshold and no severity**, by comparing against THIS design's own distribution and refusing a verdict. `BL-42`'s `realized_via_component` guard is the counter-example: it solved a real noise problem measured on one storyflow adopt trial and created greenfield-increment blindness that nothing recorded for six weeks.

ENFORCEMENT: **advisory, on Anthony's word 2026-08-14.** He was asked whether shipping a check tuned to one design's data should stop the build, and answered that it is advice. That is the honest answer: *"is this overfitted?"* is a judgement about why code was written, which is not a property the graph can see — so an enforced version would owe a detector nobody could write, leaving a 0.6 finding open forever. **Advisory here means findable and quotable in review, not weak.**
